genomoncology-biomcp-root.description: Search and retrieve biomedical data - genes, variants, clinical trials, diagnostic tests, articles, drugs, diseases, pathways, proteins, adverse events, pharmacogenomics, and phenotype-disease matching. Use for gene function, variant pathogenicity, trials, diagnostics, drug safety, pathway context, disease workups, and literature evidence.

genomoncology-biomcp-sdlc-archive-biomcp.description: Do biomedical literature and variant research with the BioMCP CLI, and file what you learn about the tool itself as issues in the biomcp repo.
